sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: -2 Harmony. Spiritual Actions and Reactions require 1 additional burned die.

sections.label: NATURAL RECOVERY
sections.html: Stabilize: contain the ongoing spiritual cause and establish an appropriate anchor through a person, rite, vessel, place, or equivalent method. Recovery: extended safe treatment appropriate to the injury, or qualifying Critical healing. Exact duration remains to be finalized.
